decisions.decision: Commissioners to send their input on the modified ARPA request to Paula as soon as possible, so that she and John can compose the final letter to the Select Board.
decisions.quote: the commissioners will send input to paula asap.

decisions.decision: The Commission agreed the draft ARPA request looks good.
decisions.quote: the commissioners agreed that the request looks good.

decisions.decision: The modified ARPA request is to go to the Select Board for its 7/11 meeting.
decisions.quote: paula stated the modified request needs to go to the select board for their 7/11 meeting.

decisions.decision: The Commission agreed to post a joint meeting on 7/11 with the Select Board for Mike Mackin’s appointment.
decisions.quote: paula asked about posting a joint meeting on 7/11 with the select board for mike mackin's appointment and the commission agreed.

decisions.decision: The Commission agreed it must make sure the grease-trap overflow does not happen again; further investigation to follow, with the grease-trap records being pulled.
decisions.quote: the commission discussed and agreed they need to make sure it does not happen again.

decisions.decision: Paula is to discuss the manhole issue with Adam at the next Town Counsel hours; Bill is to talk to Joe Progin about investigating other manholes (recommended, not voted).
decisions.quote: paula will discuss the issue with adam during the next town counsel hours and she recommended having bill talk to joe progin to do more investigating into other manholes.

decisions.decision: John suggested re-issuing the IFB as one contract; Paula said the quantities were already modified and the IFB was ready to send out. No vote recorded.
decisions.quote: john suggested putting the ifb out again as one contract and paula stated bill has already modified the quantities, so they are ready to send it out now.

decisions.decision: Paula has tentatively scheduled Wright Pierce to attend the 7/25 meeting to discuss their proposal for redirecting flow; Paula is preparing the 7/25 agenda early.
decisions.quote: has tentatively scheduled wright pierce to attend that meeting to discuss their proposal for redirecting flow.

decisions.decision: Pond View update added to the 7/25 agenda at Brett’s request.
decisions.quote: brett had asked for an update on pond view and has added it to 7/25 agenda.

decisions.decision: John will pass on information about the Mass. Ave. backup as it becomes available.
decisions.quote: john will pass on information as available.

budget_items.topic: FY23 User Charges received to date
budget_items.what_was_recorded: User Charges received as of 6/27 were well below the forecast.
budget_items.quote: as of 6/27, they have $945,366.77 in user charges, which is much less than the forecasted $1.1 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Business Manager's conservative year-end User Charges estimate, with the year ending positive through transfers and encumbrances.
budget_items.quote: paula estimated conservatively there will be $975k in user charges but will end the year positive due to moving money from other line items and encumbrances.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected surplus, which may rise if the Revenue figure increases.
budget_items.quote: there will be a surplus of about $20k which may increase if the revenue figure increases.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The usual contribution to Retained Earnings will not be made this year.
budget_items.quote: they will not have the money they usually put into retained earnings, due to the personnel shift and upgrades done.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Under current rules, contracts above $10K need three bids and above $50K must go out to bid; the Business Manager suggested spending more on jetting, manholes and I/I.
budget_items.quote: right now, they are limited to spending less than $10k on contracts. if more than $10k, they need 3 bids and if more than $50k, it will need to go out for bid.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total FY23 encumbrances reported at just over $50K.
budget_items.quote: paula reported there is just over $50k in encumbrances.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Martinez Road Construction repaired manhole covers at a cost reported as just under $10K; no bill yet received.
budget_items.quote: martinez road construction repaired 16 manhole covers on mass. ave. for just under $10k but she has not received a bill yet.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Clean Basins to jet lines for a quoted price.
budget_items.quote: clean basins will be jetting lines soon for $9,800.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposal for evaluating feasibility of redirecting flows.
budget_items.quote: paula has a proposal of $9,100 from wright pierce for evaluation of feasibility of redirecting flows.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Additional manhole covers ordered at the stated cost.
budget_items.quote: she also ordered more manhole covers for $3,624 and she has estimated bills for telephone and utilities.

budget_items.topic: Waste disposal and asphalt, PJ Keatings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cost of waste disposal and asphalt from PJ Keatings.
budget_items.quote: the cost of waste disposal and asphalt from pj keatings is $1,195.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimated emergency jetting cost, plus police details, which are not priced in the minutes.
budget_items.quote: the emergency jetting on mass ave is estimated at $2,800 plus the money for police details.

budget_items.topic: PFAS and flood plain costs (ARPA context)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chair estimated the PFAS issue could cost $200-300K and is an unfunded mandate; Commissioners noted costs would fall on the sewer budget.
budget_items.quote: john replied that the pfas issue is a much greater unknown than the flood plain issue, which could be $200-300k.

budget_items.topic: Generator cost share of system maintenance bid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Generator cost is a share of the Chad Empey bid, reported as 11% overall.
budget_items.quote: bill said he favors 1 contract and noted on chad empey's bid, the generator cost was only 11% overall.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The single bid received was significantly above estimate; the IFB will be re-bid with revised quantities.
budget_items.quote: system maintenance - paula stated they received 1 bid from chad empey and it was significantly more than they anticipated.
